column2: Purpose: Log your Wake Up Time and each Deep Work Hour's finish time once per day so you have a single organized record of your focus and efficiency for the month.
1. Fill in one row per day, leave a cell blank on any day you did not track that metric.
2. Enter Wake Up Time and every Hour Time in h:mm AM/PM format (for example, 9:00 AM), do not type plain numbers into these columns.
3. Hour 1 through Hour 4 are the requirement, Hour 5 through Hour 10 are only there for the days you complete more than four hours.
4. Get Up Immediately is a dropdown, Yes or No, for whether you got up right when your alarm went off.
5. Notes is free text for anything you want to remember about that day.
6. Total Hours, 4h Consistency, 4h Efficiency and every Hour Efficiency column are automatically calculated, do not type into them.
7. Average Hours is only calculated in the Week and Total rows, the grey daily cells are left empty on purpose because a single day average is the same as that day Total Hours.
8. Each week automatically totals or averages into the purple Week row beneath it, do not edit the Week rows directly.
9. The red Total row at the very bottom of this tab automatically calculates the entire month, do not edit it directly.
